notes.title: Dead Man's Nightmares release date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone today I wanted to make an announcement related to Dead Man's Nightmares release date.
As you know the plan was for Dead Man's Nightmares to release at some point in 2024 but as the situation is seen, it was imminent and the game will now be released at an unknown point.

Every day the game becomes more ambitious overcoming goals that are seen as impossible at some moment but know they are possible! 

So Dead Man's Nightmares is going to be delayed so gamers can play the game as they should!
